name: dialog-modal
description: A window that covers the app and takes the whole interaction until it is dismissed. More than one component binds it, which is the point: written once here it is one contract each of them answers, rather than the same rules implied separately at each. Which components those are is each one's own <Name>.behaviour.json, because a binding travels with the component and a list here is stale the day one of them moves to a pattern of its own. Its focus and Escape requirements are modal-focus's, which a binding adds with `also`.
